lines: d34: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Henry Myers is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d34: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d34: 🕯️ Henry Myers is dead — a stranger. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d34: What Henry kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d34: "Henry's gone." Wanjiru looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Henry." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d34: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Oliver blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d34: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d34: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d34: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Henry Myers, 34 days. The mantle passes to Oliver Schmid.
d34: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Oliver Schmid, 65 — a Dentist. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Green Whisper, Echo Location, Beard Moss.
d34: At the grave, Kim, Wanjiru, Aria and 2 more speak for Oliver — "Henry trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d34: The fire knew Oliver before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
